# From idea to global stage

**Sara, Isabela and María José participated in the Enel WinDesign, held in Rome, as the only representatives from Latin America.**

**Their proposal, focused on redesigning wind turbines, integrated engineering and design to contribute to its social acceptance, with the support of the GRID research group. The project was selected as one of the 30 finalists out of 529 teams and exhibited at the National Museum of 21st Century Arts.**

**The experience strengthened his training process and his projection in international scenarios.**

###### EAFIT and Ecopetrol identify opportunities to strengthen sustainable water management in Colombia

What to do with large volumes of water that are currently discarded and how to turn them into a reserve for the future? That was one of the questions that motivated an interdisciplinary team of researchers from EAFIT to develop, together with Ecopetrol, a pioneering project in Colombia.
